text: Can't do a single pull-up yet?
Pulling down from overhead builds your lats, the muscles that make your back look wide.
Pull-ups are the hardest. Assisted pull-ups with a band or machine help you build up. Lat pulldowns let you pick the weight. And single-arm cable pulldowns let you focus on one side.
Use pulldowns and assisted pull-ups to build up to your first real pull-up.
